Use AND to require multiple terms: - ceramics AND vase [More](#hood-api-keywords-extended-desc) Close Overlay ## Keyword Search Information ### For best results, use one word: - Yoruba - Baroque - Rembrandt ### Use *AND* for combinations: - American AND ceramics AND vase - Birch AND bark AND container - Picasso AND photograph ### Use quotes for phrases and full names: - "Bark Painting" - "English Sheraton Barometer" - "Tuning Fork Mallet" ### If your search includes 3 or more words, you may use a mix of quotes and *AND*: - "birch bark" AND container # Plan Your Visit Explore information and resources for your visit to the Hood Museum. - ![In the foreground there are pink flowers and in the background is a grey brick building with letting that reads Hood Museum of Art.](https://hoodmuseum.dartmouth.edu/sites/hoodmuseum.prod/files/styles/slide/public/hoodmuseum/images/facade_tile_photo_by_rob_strong_16x9_2000px.jpg?itok=JysIdZQ0 "The Hood Museum of Art's north entrance. Photo by Rob Strong.") **LEFT** The Hood Museum of Art's north entrance. Photo by Rob Strong. ## Collection slideshow **Admission is free and open to all.** ## Museum Hours\* Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday: 11:00 am–5:00 pm Saturday: 10:00 am–5:00 pm Closed Sunday, Monday, and Tuesday \*Museum spaces will remain open for scheduled events outside of these hours. ## 2026 Holiday Closures Independence Day: July 3 and 4 Thanksgiving: November 26 and 27 Dartmouth Winter Break (Dates subject to change, please call the museum to confirm): December 23–January 5, 2027 ## Museum Address 6 East Wheelock Street Hanover, NH 03755 ## Parking The museum can be accessed from both Wheelock Street and Lebanon Street. Metered street parking is available on Wheelock Street, Lebanon Street, and downtown Hanover. Additionally, there is a paid parking garage located at 7 Lebanon Street. For more information on parking in Hanover, including free parking days, **[click here](https://www.hanovernh.org/257/Visitor-Parking)**. Vehicles parked in designated handicap parking zones or in paid public parking areas displaying a valid handicap license plate, decal, tag or card may park for free, but for no more than ten consecutive hours in the Marshall Lot and Hanover Parking Facility and for no more than three hours in all other designated handicap parking zones. [**Click here**](https://www.hanovernh.org/245/Handicapped-Parking) for more information. ## Bus (Advance Transit) In the Upper Valley, ride the [Advance Transit](https://advancetransit.com/) Brown, Green, Yellow, or Orange Routes to the Hanover Inn stop, or take the Blue Route to the Hanover Park stop.  [![5th graders from Ottauquechee School, VT, imitate the figures depicted in the six gypsum reliefs from Ashurnasirpal II's Northwest Palace at Nimrud.](https://hoodmuseum.dartmouth.edu/sites/hoodmuseum.prod/files/styles/233x187/public/hoodmuseum/images/quarterly_image_kim_01.22.25.png?itok=geguWhOd)
